title: Read Emotions
subtitle: 「讀懂情緒／辨識感受」，究竟是哪一種 read emotions？
description: 「讀懂情緒／辨識感受」，究竟是哪一種 read emotions？

words.note: 最直接的近義說法之一，強調察覺並辨認別人正在感受甚麼，例如開心、焦慮、尷尬或憤怒。
words.example: Young children gradually learn to recognise feelings from facial expressions and tone of voice.
words.exampleZh: 幼兒會逐漸學會從面部表情和語氣辨識情緒。

exercises.original: Children gradually learn to read emotions from other people's faces.
exercises.zh: 孩子會逐漸學會從別人的面孔辨識情緒。
exercises.upgrade: recognise feelings · 辨識情緒；認出感受

options.explanation: read minds = read minds 是知道別人想法；本句只談從面孔判斷感受。
show emotion = 這是表達自己的情緒，不是理解別人的。
recognise feelings = from other people's faces 顯示任務是辨識別人的感受，因此 recognise feelings 最直接。
control emotions = 是調節情緒，不是辨識。
guess feelings = 若只是 guess，未必依據臉部線索；本句明確是由 faces 判斷。
imitate expressions = 模仿表情不等於理解其情緒。

exercises.original: The activity helps students read emotions such as embarrassment and excitement.
exercises.zh: 這項活動幫助學生辨識尷尬和興奮等情緒。
exercises.upgrade: recognise feelings · 辨識情緒；認出感受

options.explanation: control emotions = 活動不是教學生壓抑或調節感受。
show feelings = 不是要求學生表達自己。
read minds = 不是猜想法。
recognise feelings = embarrassment 和 excitement 都是具體 feelings，所以 recognise feelings 最精確。
identify people = 不是辨認人物身份。
copy emotions = 不是模仿。

exercises.original: He finds it difficult to read emotions when people hide how they feel.
exercises.zh: 當別人隱藏感受時，他很難辨識情緒。
exercises.upgrade: recognise feelings · 辨識情緒；認出感受

options.explanation: empathise = 即使能 empathise，也要先察覺感受；本句重點是 recognition difficulty。
control emotion = 不是他控制自己的情緒。
express feelings = 是對方在表達與否，不是他的能力。
read thoughts = 隱藏情緒不等於隱藏 thoughts。
recognise feelings = hide how they feel 直接指辨識別人的感受，因此答案自然。
imitate = 不合。

words.note: 較正式，強調根據表情、眼神、語氣、姿勢等線索推斷他人的情緒狀態；比單純 recognise 更著重理解線索所代表的意思。
words.example: Good listeners can interpret emotional cues even when very little is said directly.
words.exampleZh: 善於聆聽的人即使對方沒有直接說太多，也能解讀情緒線索。

exercises.original: Good negotiators can read emotions from tone of voice and small changes in posture.
exercises.zh: 優秀談判者能從語氣和姿勢細微變化解讀情緒線索。
exercises.upgrade: interpret emotional cues · 解讀情緒線索

options.explanation: read minds = 語氣與姿勢只能提供線索，不能直接揭示完整想法。
imitate behaviour = 模仿姿勢不等於理解其意義。
control emotions = 不是調節自己的情緒。
interpret emotional cues = tone of voice 和 posture 都是 emotional cues，重點是解讀其含義。
guess randomly = 本句有具體 tone/posture evidence，不是隨意猜。
show feelings = 主語是在讀別人，不是在表達自己。

exercises.original: The training teaches staff how to read emotions when customers do not state their feelings directly.
exercises.zh: 培訓教職員在顧客沒有直接說出感受時如何解讀情緒線索。
exercises.upgrade: interpret emotional cues · 解讀情緒線索

options.explanation: ask direct questions = 可以幫助理解，但原句說沒有直接 stated feelings，重點是 cues。
read minds = 沒有聲稱能知道顧客思想。
manage emotions = 不是 staff 自己的 emotion regulation。
imitate customers = 不合服務溝通。
interpret emotional cues = 沒有直接說出情緒時，需要靠間接 cues 推斷，interpret emotional cues 最精確。
identify faces = 不是身份辨認。

exercises.original: Researchers tested whether participants could read emotions accurately from short video clips.
exercises.zh: 研究人員測試參加者能否從短片準確解讀情緒線索。
exercises.upgrade: interpret emotional cues · 解讀情緒線索

options.explanation: remember faces = 不是記憶身份。
control reactions = 不是 emotion regulation task。
guess personalities = personality 比短暫 emotion 更穩定，並非本句目標。
copy gestures = 不是模仿 task。
read thoughts = 不合研究測量。
interpret emotional cues = 短片提供多種非語言訊號，研究的是能否準確解讀 cues。

words.note: 當 read emotions 主要依靠面部表情判斷情緒時最精確；不涵蓋聲音、姿勢等其他線索。
words.example: She can usually read facial expressions accurately in stressful situations.
words.exampleZh: 她通常能在緊張情況下準確讀懂面部表情。

exercises.original: She can usually read emotions from a person's face very quickly.
exercises.zh: 她通常能很快從一個人的臉上讀懂情緒。
exercises.upgrade: read facial expressions · 讀懂面部表情

options.explanation: read body language = 本句特別限定 face，不是整體身體姿勢。
identify faces = 是辨認身份，不是判斷情緒。
read minds = 不能由臉直接知道完整想法。
copy expressions = 是模仿，不是理解。
read facial expressions = 線索明確來自 a person's face，因此 read facial expressions 最精確。
control feelings = 不合。

exercises.original: Doctors sometimes need to read emotions in patients who are unable to speak.
exercises.zh: 醫生有時需要讀懂無法說話病人的面部表情。
exercises.upgrade: read facial expressions · 讀懂面部表情

options.explanation: listen to tone = 病人不能說話，沒有語音線索。
read minds = 醫生只能根據可觀察表情判斷。
show empathy = 是之後的回應，不是先讀表情的技能。
recognise identity = 不是確認病人身份。
imitate pain = 不合。
read facial expressions = 無法說話時，臉部成為主要情緒線索，因此答案非常直接。

exercises.original: The actor was skilled at reading emotions shown in subtle movements around the eyes and mouth.
exercises.zh: 這名演員很擅長讀懂眼睛和嘴巴周圍細微動作所顯示的情緒。
exercises.upgrade: read facial expressions · 讀懂面部表情

options.explanation: read facial expressions = eyes and mouth 是明確 facial-expression clues。
read body language = 眼睛和嘴巴屬面部，而非一般 body posture。
guess feelings = 本句有細微可觀察線索，不是無根據猜測。
read thoughts = 情緒線索不等於 thought content。
control expressions = 不是控制自己的面部。
recognise people = 不是身份辨認。

words.note: 當情緒判斷主要來自身體姿勢、動作、距離或手勢時適用；重點不是臉部，而是非語言身體訊號。
words.example: Experienced negotiators often read body language as carefully as spoken words.
words.exampleZh: 有經驗的談判者往往像留意言語一樣仔細讀懂身體語言。

exercises.original: She tried to read emotions from his posture and the way he avoided eye contact.
exercises.zh: 她試著從他的姿勢和避開眼神接觸的方式讀懂情緒。
exercises.upgrade: read body language · 讀懂身體語言

options.explanation: read facial expressions = 本句核心是 posture 和 eye-contact behaviour，不只是臉部肌肉。
read minds = 不能由姿勢知道完整想法。
control emotions = 不是調節自己的情緒。
copy posture = 模仿不等於解讀。
identify identity = 不合。
read body language = posture 和 eye-contact behaviour 都是 body-language cues。

exercises.original: Interviewers often read emotions through gestures before candidates answer.
exercises.zh: 面試官常在候選人回答前透過動作讀懂身體語言。
exercises.upgrade: read body language · 讀懂身體語言

options.explanation: read body language = gestures 是 body language 的典型例子。
listen to words = 回答前還沒有 verbal content。
read facial expressions = gestures 不限於臉。
read thoughts = 不能把非語言線索當作直接思想。
show emotion = 主語不是在表達自己。
imitate gestures = 不合面試目的。

exercises.original: The coach could read emotions from the athlete's shoulders and movements.
exercises.zh: 教練能從運動員的肩膀和動作讀懂身體語言。
exercises.upgrade: read body language · 讀懂身體語言

options.explanation: read facial expressions = 線索在 shoulders/movements，不是臉。
read body language = shoulders 和 movements 都屬身體語言，因此答案最精確。
guess performance = 不是預測成績。
control emotion = 不合。
recognise identity = 不合。
copy movement = 不是模仿。

words.meaning: 察覺到情緒；感受到對方感受
words.note: 較口語，表示從細微變化中察覺對方的情緒，即使對方沒有直接說出來。
words.example: She quickly picked up on his frustration during the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 她很快便察覺到他在會議中的挫折感。

exercises.original: She quickly read his emotions even though he said he was fine.
exercises.zh: 即使他說自己沒事，她仍很快察覺到他的感受。
exercises.upgrade: pick up on feelings · 察覺到情緒；感受到對方感受

options.explanation: pick up on feelings = even though he said he was fine 表示從細微線索察覺真正感受，口語最自然用 pick up on。
believed his words = 這會忽略非語言線索，和句子形成的反差相反。
read minds = 不是知道他想甚麼，只是察覺情緒。
controlled his feelings = 她不能控制對方的情緒。
copied his expression = 不合。
identified his face = 不是身份問題。

exercises.original: Good teachers often read emotions before students ask for help.
exercises.zh: 優秀教師常在學生求助前已察覺到他們的情緒。
exercises.upgrade: pick up on feelings · 察覺到情緒；感受到對方感受

options.explanation: give advice = 那是察覺後可能採取的行動，不是 read emotions 本身。
pick up on feelings = 在學生未明說前已察覺 feelings，pick up on 很自然。
read thoughts = 不能假設知道學生想法。
show emotion = 不是教師展示自己感受。
control behaviour = 不合。
recognise names = 不合。

exercises.original: He is good at reading emotions in a group when the atmosphere changes.
exercises.zh: 當群體氣氛改變時，他很擅長察覺大家的感受。
exercises.upgrade: pick up on feelings · 察覺到情緒；感受到對方感受

options.explanation: measuring mood scientifically = 本句是日常敏感度，不是正式測量。
reading minds = 不合。
pick up on feelings = atmosphere changes 是細微社交線索，口語用 pick up on feelings 很貼切。
managing emotions = 不是調節。
imitating others = 不合。
identifying people = 不合。

words.note: 強調直覺或整體感受到別人的情緒狀態，不一定能指出具體是哪一個表情或線索。
words.example: He could sense the tension in the room before anyone spoke.
words.exampleZh: 在任何人開口前，他已感受到房間裡的緊張氣氛。

exercises.original: He could read the tension in the room before anyone spoke.
exercises.zh: 在任何人說話前，他已感受到房間裡的緊張情緒。
exercises.upgrade: sense emotions · 感受到情緒；察覺情緒

options.explanation: interpret words = 還沒有人說話，所以沒有 words 可解讀。
sense emotions = 沒有單一明確線索、但能整體察覺 tension，sense 最自然。
read minds = 只是感受到 tension，不是知道想法。
control emotions = 不合。
identify expressions = 句子未限定臉部。
imitate behaviour = 不合。

exercises.original: She seemed able to read emotions even when people tried to hide them.
exercises.zh: 即使別人試圖隱藏情緒，她似乎仍能感受到。
exercises.upgrade: sense emotions · 感受到情緒；察覺情緒

options.explanation: read thoughts = 知道情緒和知道思想不同。
show feelings = 不是她在表達。
sense emotions = 當線索很微弱而語氣偏直覺察覺時，sense emotions 很合適。
control others = 不能由 sense 推到控制。
guess blindly = 本句暗示敏銳察覺，不是無根據猜。
recognise faces = 不是身份。

exercises.original: Experienced nurses can often read anxiety before a patient mentions it.
exercises.zh: 有經驗的護士常在病人提及焦慮前已感受到焦慮。
exercises.upgrade: sense emotions · 感受到情緒；察覺情緒

options.explanation: diagnose anxiety disorder = 察覺焦慮不等於正式診斷。
read minds = 不合。
control anxiety = 不是處理情緒。
sense emotions = 在病人未明說前察覺 anxiety，sense 很自然，但不應誇大成 diagnosis。
copy expression = 不合。
recognise identity = 不合。

words.note: 較正式、分析性，表示辨認可觀察到的情緒訊號；常見於心理學、溝通研究或技術語境。
words.example: The study examined how accurately participants could detect emotional signals in speech.
words.exampleZh: 研究檢視參加者能多準確地察覺語音中的情緒訊號。

exercises.original: The experiment tested whether listeners could read emotions in a speaker's voice.
exercises.zh: 實驗測試聽者能否察覺說話者聲音中的情緒訊號。
exercises.upgrade: detect emotional signals · 察覺情緒訊號

options.explanation: identify the speaker = 辨認說話者身份和判斷情緒不同。
read facial expressions = 只有聲音，沒有臉部資料。
detect emotional signals = experiment + speaker's voice 是分析聲學情緒訊號的典型語境。
control reactions = 不是調節自己的反應。
imitate tone = 不是模仿。
guess personality = voice emotion 不等於穩定人格。

exercises.original: The software is designed to read emotions from changes in speech rhythm and pitch.
exercises.zh: 這套軟件旨在從語速節奏和音高變化中察覺情緒訊號。
exercises.upgrade: detect emotional signals · 察覺情緒訊號

options.explanation: read minds = 軟件不能知道完整 thought content。
recognise faces = 資料來源是 speech。
show emotion = 軟件不是在表達感受。
detect emotional signals = rhythm and pitch 是可量化 signals，因此 detect emotional signals 很精確。
control emotion = 不是調節。
measure vocabulary = rhythm/pitch 不是詞彙量。

exercises.original: Researchers examined how accurately children could read emotions from brief vocal sounds.
exercises.zh: 研究人員檢視兒童能否從短促聲音準確察覺情緒訊號。
exercises.upgrade: detect emotional signals · 察覺情緒訊號

options.explanation: identify words = brief vocal sounds 未必包含詞語。
recognise faces = 沒有視覺線索。
copy sounds = 不是模仿測試。
control feelings = 不合。
detect emotional signals = 研究測的是從 vocal sounds 中偵測情緒訊號，答案最自然。
read thoughts = 不合。

words.note: 較正式，表示透過感官和認知察覺他人的情緒；常見於心理學和 emotional intelligence 語境。
words.example: The task measures how well people perceive emotions in faces and voices.
words.exampleZh: 這項任務測量人們從面孔和聲音中感知情緒的能力。

exercises.original: The test measures how well people can read emotions in faces and voices.
exercises.zh: 這項測驗衡量人們從面孔和聲音中感知情緒的能力。
exercises.upgrade: perceive emotions · 感知情緒；察覺情緒

options.explanation: empathise = 同理心比單純 perception 更深一層。
identify people = faces 在此用來判斷 emotion，不是身份。
control emotions = 不是 regulation test。
perceive emotions = 心理測量語境中，從 faces/voices 察覺 emotion 常稱 perceive emotions。
imitate expressions = 不是模仿。
guess intentions = 情緒和意圖不同。

exercises.original: Some people are better than others at reading emotions accurately.
exercises.zh: 有些人比其他人更能準確感知情緒。
exercises.upgrade: perceive emotions · 感知情緒；察覺情緒

options.explanation: managing emotions = emotion management 是另一種能力。
showing feelings = 是表達能力。
reading thoughts = 不是同一構念。
imitating others = 不合。
perceive emotions = 若作為 emotional-intelligence 能力來談，perceiving emotions 是正式自然用語。
remembering faces = 不合。

exercises.original: The study looked at whether stress affects people's ability to read emotions.
exercises.zh: 研究探討壓力會否影響人們感知情緒的能力。
exercises.upgrade: perceive emotions · 感知情緒；察覺情緒

options.explanation: regulate emotions = 可受壓力影響，但不是本句測的 ability。
express emotion = 不是表達能力。
recognise identity = 不合。
guess motives = motives 與 emotions 不同。
copy gestures = 不合。
perceive emotions = 研究心理能力的正式語體用 perceive emotions 最合適。

words.note: 當 read emotions 不只是辨認情緒名稱，還包括理解對方當下整體情緒狀態時適用。
words.example: Counsellors need to understand emotional states without making assumptions too quickly.
words.exampleZh: 輔導員需要理解情緒狀態，而不能太快作出假設。

exercises.original: Counsellors need to read emotions without jumping to conclusions.
exercises.zh: 輔導員需要理解情緒狀態，而不能太快下結論。
exercises.upgrade: understand emotional states · 理解情緒狀態

options.explanation: read minds = counsellor 不能假設知道完整思想。
diagnose immediately = without jumping to conclusions 正是反對過快診斷。
control emotions = 不是 regulation。
imitate feelings = 不合。
understand emotional states = 輔導語境不只認出情緒名稱，還要理解整體 emotional state。
identify faces = 不合。

exercises.original: Parents often try to read emotions when a child cannot explain what is wrong.
exercises.zh: 當孩子無法解釋問題時，父母常嘗試理解其情緒狀態。
exercises.upgrade: understand emotional states · 理解情緒狀態

options.explanation: read thoughts = 孩子無法解釋不代表父母能知道思想。
control behaviour = 可能之後處理行為，但本句先理解感受。
show empathy = 是回應方式，不是同義替換。
identify mood words = 孩子甚至可能未能說出詞語。
imitate expression = 不合。
understand emotional states = 當 verbal explanation 不足時，重點是理解孩子當下整體 emotional state。

exercises.original: The doctor tried to read the patient's emotions before discussing the diagnosis.
exercises.zh: 醫生在討論診斷前嘗試理解病人的情緒狀態。
exercises.upgrade: understand emotional states · 理解情緒狀態

options.explanation: understand emotional states = 醫生要先理解病人的整體情緒反應，understand emotional state 比單一 cue 更全面。
diagnose the emotion = emotion 不等同醫療 diagnosis。
read thoughts = 不合。
control feelings = 不是醫生控制病人感受。
identify identity = 不合。
copy behaviour = 不合。

words.note: 較口語，表示估計某人當下的 mood 或情緒傾向；比精確辨認單一 emotion 稍廣。
words.example: Before raising the issue, she tried to gauge his mood.
words.exampleZh: 在提出這個問題前，她先試著判斷他的心情。

exercises.original: Before asking for a decision, she tried to read his emotions.
exercises.zh: 在要求他作決定前，她先試著判斷他的心情。
exercises.upgrade: gauge someone's mood · 判斷某人的心情

options.explanation: read his mind = 她不是試圖知道他會作甚麼決定，而是先判斷 mood。
control his mood = 不合。
copy his expression = 不合。
identify his face = 不是身份。
show sympathy = 是回應方式，不是判斷狀態。
gauge someone's mood = 在提出敏感要求前先估計對方當下心情，gauge his mood 很自然。

exercises.original: The manager paused to read the team's emotions after announcing the change.
exercises.zh: 經理宣布改動後停下來判斷團隊的情緒。
exercises.upgrade: gauge someone's mood · 判斷某人的心情

options.explanation: gauge someone's mood = announcement 後評估團體整體 mood，gauge 特別自然。
measure productivity = 不是工作表現。
read minds = 不合。
control reactions = 不是強制改變反應。
identify emotions precisely = mood 比精確 emotion label 更整體。
imitate body language = 不合。

exercises.original: She looked around the room to read emotions before continuing her presentation.
exercises.zh: 她環視房間，在繼續簡報前先判斷聽眾心情。
exercises.upgrade: gauge someone's mood · 判斷某人的心情

options.explanation: recognise faces = 環視不是為確認身份。
gauge someone's mood = presenter 在繼續前估計 audience mood，是典型 gauge the mood。
read thoughts = 無法知道每人想法。
control emotion = 不合。
copy gestures = 不合。
measure attendance = 不是數人數。

words.note: 強調根據間接證據、語氣或行為作出推論；表示不是直接知道，而是由線索推斷。
words.example: From his silence and posture, she inferred that he felt uncomfortable.
words.exampleZh: 她從他的沉默和姿勢推斷他感到不自在。

exercises.original: From his silence and tense posture, she read that he was uncomfortable.
exercises.zh: 她從他的沉默和緊繃姿勢推斷他感到不自在。
exercises.upgrade: infer feelings · 推斷感受

options.explanation: infer feelings = silence and tense posture 是證據，從證據得到結論最精確用 infer。
read his mind = 她只是由 evidence 推斷感受，沒有知道完整想法。
diagnosed anxiety = uncomfortable 不等於正式診斷。
copied his posture = 不是模仿。
controlled his feelings = 不合。
identified him = 不合。

exercises.original: The teacher read the student's frustration from repeated sighs and unfinished work.
exercises.zh: 老師從反覆嘆氣和未完成的作業推斷學生感到挫折。
exercises.upgrade: infer feelings · 推斷感受

options.explanation: guessed randomly = 本句有 repeated sighs/unfinished work 作依據。
infer feelings = 有具體行為證據支持判斷，因此 infer feelings 比單純 guess 更精確。
read thoughts = 不需要知道學生思想。
controlled frustration = 不是 regulation。
showed empathy = 是可能的下一步。
identified personality = frustration 是暫時情緒，不是 personality trait。

exercises.original: Researchers asked participants to read emotions from a character's behaviour in a short story.
exercises.zh: 研究人員要求參加者從短篇故事中角色的行為推斷感受。
exercises.upgrade: infer feelings · 推斷感受

options.explanation: read facial expressions = 文字故事未必提供可見面部表情。
detect vocal cues = 沒有聲音。
infer feelings = 文字中的 behaviour 是間接 evidence，因此最自然是 infer feelings。
read minds = 只能由故事 evidence 推論。
imitate behaviour = 不合。
control emotions = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 猜情緒不等於讀懂情緒 guess 可以沒有足夠證據；read emotions 通常依靠表情、語氣、姿勢等線索作判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Reading emotions uses cues; guessing may not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 讀心不等於讀情緒 read minds 暗示知道別人在想甚麼；read emotions 只表示根據可觀察線索理解感受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can read emotional cues without knowing someone's thoughts.

falseSynonyms.zh: 表達情緒不等於辨識情緒 show emotion 是把自己的感受表現出來；read emotions 是理解別人的情緒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON One person shows emotion; another person reads it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 控制情緒不等於辨識情緒 control emotions 是調節自己的情緒反應；read emotions 是察覺或理解情緒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Emotion regulation and emotion recognition are different skills.

falseSynonyms.zh: 同理不完全等於讀懂情緒 empathise 是理解或分享別人的感受；通常要先察覺情緒，但它還包含更深的情感理解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Recognising sadness is not the same as empathising with it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 人臉辨識不等於情緒辨識 facial recognition 通常指辨認某人的身份；read facial expressions 是解讀臉上顯示的情緒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Facial recognition identifies a person; emotion recognition interprets an expression.

falseSynonyms.zh: 情緒與情緒線索不同 emotion 是感受本身；emotional cue 是讓你推斷那個感受的訊號。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A frown is a cue; frustration may be the emotion behind it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 解讀不等於模仿 interpret 是理解線索所代表的意思；imitate 是模仿表情、語氣或動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can interpret an expression without copying it.
